name: Load WebViewer App ( {webViewer; url , initialProps } )
purpose: Vendored FM WebViewer Bridge loader: builds a URL with a hash of properties (isFM, file name, FileMaker version plus any initialProps) through Compile URL, resets then points the named web viewer at it, and waits up to 10 loops for the page to load or for a cancel flag. Returns an error JSON on timeout or cancel. Sets $$WebVeiwer.Loading while loading.
open_question: Typos in global names ($$WebVeiwer.Loading vs $$WebViewer.LoadApp.Cancel) are consistent within the module. Loop counter $n is never initialized (starts empty). Callers are in scripts not in this share; see callers column.

name: Execute JavaScript ( { function, parameter, ...} )
purpose: Vendored FM WebViewer Bridge call: sends a JavaScript function call to a web viewer app by rebuilding the viewer URL with a hash holding function name, parameter and an optional callback script/file, using Compile URL, then Set Web Viewer. Shows a developer error dialog when the web viewer or URL is missing.
open_question: Callbacks from the web app into FileMaker (FileMaker.PerformScript) are made by the web page, not shown here; the callback script named in the hash is a hidden caller.

name: Is WebViewer Loading
purpose: Vendored FM WebViewer Bridge helper that returns whether the web viewer app is still loading, from the global $$WebVeiwer.Loading. Nothing calls it; effect owner would be client-ui.

name: Close WebViewer App
purpose: Vendored FM WebViewer Bridge helper that cancels a web viewer load in progress by setting $$WebViewer.LoadApp.Cancel when $$WebVeiwer.Loading is set. Nothing calls it; effect owner would be client-ui.
